title: New Etobicoke Civic Centre Rises Above Grade in Transforming Six Points
summary: The new Etobicoke Civic Centre has emerged above grade. Designed by Henning Larsen Architects with Adamson Associates Architects as Architect of Record for CreateTO, the multi-volume civic complex is rising at the southeast corner of Bloor Street West and Kipling Avenue in the transforming Six Points district where there was once a mid-city interchange.
